column1: # In-page actions (code in hook.js). They run in this order, on the page's own dataset, right after the page opened.

column3: what
Switch to the second dataset in the dataset menu (the small example CRB)
Switch back to the session's own dataset (loads the large dataset again)
Colour the projection by the next column in "Colour by"
Zoom in once with the projection's zoom button
Draw a lasso over the middle 40 % of the projection: selects cells and shows their plots and table
Colour the linked views by the next categorical or continuous field (not an expression mode)
Switch "Group" to the next grouping variable
Switch the composition plot to the other plot type (bar chart / Sankey plot)
Toggle "Show composition as percent"
Show one gene: the alphabetically first gene the gene box offers that is not shown
Show 12 genes at once: the alphabetically first 12 the gene box offers
Colour the trajectory by the next column
Open the next analysis tab
Colour the motif network by the next variable
Show the next content (table or plot); with one content, the next file, then the next category
Show the next FOV / section; when the sample has one, the next sample
Switch "Grouping variable" of the marker gene table to the next one; with one grouping, the next method
Switch the grouping variable to the next one
Switch "Grouping variable" of the pathway table to the next one; with one grouping, the next method
Colour the Trekker view by the next mode
